Definition: masculine or neuter singular of G3398 (as noun); a small space of time or degree:--a (little) (while).
BiblicalUsage: The word is 'a little', and in the New Testament it almost always measures time: a little while. Jesus tells His disciples 'a little while, and ye shall not see me', and Hebrews answers the waiting with the same phrase — yet a little while, and He that shall come will come.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the phrase is meant to steady us: the waiting is real, but it is only a little while, and the coming is certain.
